says: In today's CI, the new TT8 property passes `seed: options.seed` in its arbitrary options, though decision 0579 says the seed is set once in package setup and a law carries no seed.
proof: .decisions/0579-property-laws-use-it-prop.md line 63: `A law carries no \`seed\``; .github/ci/time-table.test.ts line 699: `{ arbitrary: { runs: queueRuns, size: 30, concurrency: 1, seed: options.seed } }`; scripts/vitest.setup.ts line 10 already sets check seed 119120.
